incidence_dimensions.scope: Constraint ranks and dimension arithmetic only; no uniform bundle transversality certified by finite sampling.

continuous_scaling.scope: Expansion is guaranteed by two invertible disjoint target blocks. Numerical stationary equations do not certify bundlewise continuity.

central_homotopy.scope: M2 plus C with values in its M2 central summand; arbitrary cochains, not only cocycles.

bounded_ball_modulus.scope: Uniform L2-modulus examples only. Ultrafilter quotient and iterated-ultrapower claims are established by the read source proof, not simulated.

commuting_tensor_independence.scope: Finite matrix factors only; nonspatial von Neumann representations require the support-projection proof.

tensor_labels.scope: Random finite samples illustrate the dimension threshold; they do not establish independence for every tuple of quotient maps.

ideal_weights.scope: Finite direct sums; extended-trace topology and arbitrary C-star ideals use the source and classical proofs.

averaged_rank_signal.scope: Finite rank-deficient examples test block normalization and spectral bound; arbitrary extended weights and stable folding are not simulated.

limitations: Selected finite mechanisms only; no quasitrace counterexample, Hochschild vanishing, character criterion or stabilization classification certified; no Lean build.
